title: How to Actually Network in 2025 (The New Way People Really Get Hired)
description:
Tired of networking that goes nowhere? In this video, I’m breaking down how people actually get hired now – and the new way to network in 2025 that actually works.

As a former recruiter and your internet big sister, I’m sharing the modern networking strategies, scripts, and mindset shifts that help you land interviews and job offers without cringe coffee chats or spammy LinkedIn messages.

In this video, you’ll learn:

• Why traditional networking events don’t work anymore (and what to do instead)

• The new way to network in 2025 so people actually remember you

• How people really get hired now (referrals, DMs, and quiet conversations)

• Exactly what to say when you reach out on LinkedIn or email

• How to network as an introvert without feeling fake or pushy

• The biggest networking mistakes that are secretly killing your job search
